title: How Adobe Supports Nonprofits in Extending Their Impact
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


- Adobe is helps resource-strapped nonprofits extend their impact with discounted creative and productivity tools.
- Adobe Express, Acrobat Pro, and Firefly help nonprofit teams create campaign content, streamline document workflows, and produce AI-powered content.
- Adobe also provides templates, training, and practical guidance to help smaller teams overcome resource and technology skill gaps.
- The San José Public Library Foundation shows the impact in practice, using Acrobat Pro to simplify contracts, reduce bottlenecks, and collaborate more efficiently.
